name: signconnect
description: Real-time accessible video calling with live captions and sign recognition

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev:https -w client"
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev && npm run build -w client
